sources.title: Algerian wholesale discovery search by image/name

observed_facts.publisher_claims: Search engine for wholesale offers publicly posted on Algerian Telegram channels; homepage states more than 330,000 products and 500+ wholesalers with daily updates.
observed_facts.free_access: Browse listings/prices; seller contact information is in paid plans.

evidence_limitations: Platform is a discovery index, not the seller, warehouse, courier, or guarantor
Counts and daily-refresh statements are platform claims, not independently audited
A surfaced offer is not a verified quote until SKU, quantity tier, date, conditions, and seller identity are captured
Seller-contact plans have a fee; no subscription or contact has been purchased or obtained

sources.title: Privacy and legal disclosure

observed_facts.context: The platform disclosure states account data may include Google account name/email/ID, search terms/counts, IP address and a device-identifying cookie; it says product search photos are used for matching and not retained.

evidence_limitations: Self-reported policy, not an independent privacy audit
Use only product photos without personal/customer details when searching
Review terms and privacy before account connection or paid subscription

sources.title: Marketplace for professional wholesale lots

observed_facts.displayed_example: Plastic storage boxes in Algiers around 2,890–3,490 DZD/pc with displayed lot size 50 pcs, posted approximately 75 days earlier in reviewed results.
observed_facts.context: The observed offers are leads for sourcing research, not an equivalent supplier quote for the bathroom basket or any shortlisted candidate.

evidence_limitations: The displayed storage item is not proven equivalent to the candidate basket
Example listing was roughly 75 days old at capture; availability and price may change
Platform legal terms say it is only a connection intermediary and does not guarantee goods, member solvency, payment, or transportation
Kabagros legal notice had fields marked to be completed when reviewed; verify trader identity and documents directly

sources.title: Platform role and limitations

observed_facts.context: Kabagros describes itself as an intermediary; the transaction forms directly between members. The legal notice leaves company registration and representative details as fields to be completed. Its terms say a verified badge only indicates that activity documentation was presented, not quality or solvency.

evidence_limitations: Platform disclosures are not independent checks of an individual lot
Seller, product, authenticity, stock, quantity, and terms must be verified directly

sources.title: Algerian wholesale marketplace

observed_facts.platform_claims: Homepage claims a wholesale marketplace with dozens of listed products, 69 wilayas covered, over 2,000 successful transactions, payment options, and delivery coverage.

evidence_limitations: These are publisher claims and have not been independently audited
Do not infer that the platform claims imply any product is in stock, profitable, or available on terms appropriate to Medad
Check seller legal identity, current availability, return terms, and fees before transacting
